messages:
maya: heads-up — I'm trying to backport the console cost/latency SDK snippet from the new observability guide into v0.9 docs. I hit two issues: the example uses the new Client.generate API (not available in v0.9) and the dashboard image link is redirecting through the CDN and the link-checker flags it.

alex: can you paste the snippet and PR link? I can sanity-check API differences quickly.

maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1987 — it's a small backport but want a quick review before I land it.

samir: for v0.9 the pattern we use is like this: ```python
from redwood_sdk import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.text.generate(
    model="redwood-1.1",
    prompt="Summarize..."
)
print(resp.output_text)
``` will that map to what you changed?

maya: yep — swapped Client.generate -> client.text.generate and adjusted streaming example. I also pointed the dashboard image at /assets/dashboards/cost_v1.png but link-checker still flagged a redirect to the CDN.

docs-bot: link-checker: WARNING: /assets/dashboards/cost_v1.png -> 301 -> https://cdn.redwood-inference.com/assets/cost_v1.png may break in older static builds.

docs-bot: link-checker failed: file not found: /assets/dashboards/cost_v1.png in branch v0.9. Suggest embedding the image in the repo (docs/static/) or use a relative ../images path.

eli: can we use a relative path like ../images/cost_v1.png instead? older versions resolve that fine.

zara: also pinging eng-runtime — the example references metric name "cost_per_token" but we renamed metrics last year; confirm if v0.9 had the old name.

alex: I'll run the snippet locally against a v0.9 environment and confirm metric names & API shape, will post the output.

maya: added a short migration note in the PR: "For v0.9 clients, replace Client.generate with client.text.generate and prefer metric token_cost_usd instead of cost_per_token." Anyone object to that wording?

samir: LGTM. while you're at it, note streaming param rename: new docs use `stream`, v0.9 expects `enable_stream`.

alex: tested the snippet locally against a v0.9 docker image. small tweak needed to the call signature (model kw arg must be 'model_name'). I pushed a commit to PR #1987 with that change.

maya: thanks — checklist before merge: 1) fix image path to a repo-relative file 2) backport snippet changes (text.generate + model_name + enable_stream) 3) add migration note 4) re-run link-checker. @docs-bot can you re-run link-checker on PR #1987?

docs-bot: Scheduled: link-checker started on PR #1987. Running checks...

docs-bot: link-checker: OK — no broken links found in PR #1987. CDN redirects detected but preserved by the docs static builder.

maya: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll merge tomorrow morning if no further objections. If anyone wants to validate the wording of the migration note, lemme know and I'll tweak it before merge. :+1:
